title: POLARIS
headline: Matching landmarks across seasonal change
summary: POLARIS is a staged vision-language pipeline for cross-temporal landmark matching. It combines object detection, semantic enrichment, depth consistency, and geometric verification, with comparison images and experiment outputs that expose each stage of the workflow.
problem: Landmarks can change substantially across seasons, lighting conditions, and viewpoints, making cross-temporal visual correspondence difficult.
contribution: A staged pipeline that combines OWL-ViT detection, FastVLM semantic enrichment, depth consistency, and keypoint/RANSAC geometric verification.
pipeline: Detect candidate landmarks in each observation.
Check depth consistency between candidate regions.
Apply keypoint and RANSAC geometric verification.
evidence: Baseline result CSV files under experiments/.
Runnable pipeline and experiment entry points in the repository.
limitations: The project is a research prototype. No stable public demo or project paper is currently approved for publication on this site.
